answer: Signed fishing licence history with fisheries authority attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because licences the authority issued across seasons of fishing, the umber of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the haven first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The harbor is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
